## Declarations and implementations

```plato
//==
// # Numeric structures
//
// Sections, in order:
//  - Component-wise algebra for the IVector interface
//  - Numeric structures components — the IVector component surface
//  - Derived functions for point-like types
//  - Derived functions for the IMatrix interface
//  - Derived functions for the IQuantity interface
//  - Geometric helpers for the IVector interface

library NumericStructures
{
    //==
    // # Component-wise algebra for the IVector interface
    //
    // The IAdditive / IArithmetic / IScalable / ILattice / IInterpolatable surface and
    // the per-component lifts of the Number intrinsics, all written once against the
    // component combinators below — written once against the IVector interface
    // rather than once per concrete type.

    //==
    // # IVector — component-wise algebra
    //
    // The IAdditive / IArithmetic / IScalable / ILattice / IInterpolatable surface,
    // all component-wise. Concrete types whose backend has a native vector
    // instruction (Number2/3/4/8 in `intrinsics.library.plato`) override these.

    // Component-wise sum.
    Add(a: IVector, b: IVector): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x + y);

    // Component-wise difference.
    Subtract(a: IVector, b: IVector): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x - y);

    // Component-wise (Hadamard) product.
    Multiply(a: IVector, b: IVector): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x * y);

    // Component-wise quotient. Precondition: no component of b is zero.
    Divide(a: IVector, b: IVector): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x / y);

    // Component-wise remainder. Precondition: no component of b is zero.
    Modulo(a: IVector, b: IVector): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x % y);

    // The vector with every component negated.
    Negative(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Negative);

    // Every component scaled by a unitless scalar.
    Multiply(self: IVector, scalar: Number): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x * scalar);

    // Every component divided by a unitless scalar. Precondition: scalar is non-zero.
    Divide(self: IVector, scalar: Number): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x / scalar);

    // Every component reduced modulo a unitless scalar. Precondition: non-zero.
    Modulo(self: IVector, scalar: Number): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x % scalar);

    // The component-wise minimum (the ILattice meet).
    Min(a: IVector, b: IVector): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x.Min(y));

    // The component-wise maximum (the ILattice join).
    Max(a: IVector, b: IVector): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x.Max(y));

    // Component-wise linear interpolation; t is unclamped.
    Lerp(a: IVector, b: IVector, t: Number): IVector
        => a.ZipComponents(b, (x, y) => x + (y - x) * t);

    //==
    // # IVector — lifted Number functions
    //
    // Each of these is the corresponding function from
    // `intrinsics.library.plato` or the `core-*` / `algebra-*` libraries
    // applied to every component — written once against the IVector interface.

    // Component-wise absolute value.
    Abs(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Abs);

    // Component-wise floor (largest whole value at or below each component).
    Floor(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Floor);

    // Component-wise ceiling (smallest whole value at or above each component).
    Ceiling(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Ceiling);

    // Component-wise truncation toward zero.
    Truncate(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Truncate);

    // Component-wise square root. Precondition: no component is negative.
    Sqrt(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Sqrt);

    // Component-wise cube root.
    Cbrt(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Cbrt);

    // Component-wise exponential (e raised to each component).
    Exp(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Exp);

    // Component-wise natural logarithm. Precondition: every component is positive.
    NaturalLog(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.NaturalLog);

    // Component-wise base-2 logarithm. Precondition: every component is positive.
    Log2(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Log2);

    // Component-wise base-10 logarithm. Precondition: every component is positive.
    Log10(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Log10);

    // Component-wise reciprocal. Precondition: no component is zero.
    Reciprocal(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Reciprocal);

    // Each component raised to the corresponding component of power.
    Pow(self: IVector, power: IVector): IVector
        => self.ZipComponents(power, (x, y) => x.Pow(y));

    // Each component raised to the same scalar power.
    Pow(self: IVector, power: Number): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Pow(power));

    // Each component given the sign of the corresponding component of sign.
    CopySign(self: IVector, sign: IVector): IVector
        => self.ZipComponents(sign, (x, y) => x.CopySign(y));

    // Component-wise fused multiply-add: self * y + z with a single rounding.
    FusedMultiplyAdd(self: IVector, y: IVector, z: IVector): IVector
        => self.ZipComponents(y, z, (a, b, c) => a.FusedMultiplyAdd(b, c));

    // Restricts every component to the scalar range [lo, hi]. Precondition: lo <= hi.
    Clamp(self: IVector, lo: Number, hi: Number): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.Clamp(lo, hi));

    // Component-wise fractional part: each component minus its floor, in [0, 1).
    FractionalPart(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.FractionalPart);

    // The component-wise complement within the unit interval: one minus each component.
    OneMinus(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.OneMinus);

    // Each component rounded to the nearest whole value, halves rounding up.
    RoundedToNearest(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.MapComponents(x => x.RoundedToNearest);
```
